steps.title: Prepare Carnoy’s fixative (50 mL)
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL container combine 30 mL 60 % (v/v) ethanol, 15 mL 30 % (v/v) chloroform, and 5 mL 10 % (v/v) glacial acetic acid; mix well. Prepare fresh just before use.

steps.title: Prepare Carmine alum solution (100 mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.2 g carmine (0.2 % w/v) and 0.5 g aluminum potassium sulfate dodecahydrate (0.5 % w/v) in ~90 mL distilled water, heat on a hot plate until boiling for 15 min, cool, filter through filter paper, bring volume to 100 mL with water and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare wash buffer (100 mL)
steps.instruction: Mix 70 mL 70 % (v/v) ethanol with 5.64 mL 36–38 % HCl (2 % v/v) and add distilled water to a final volume of 100 mL.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse and expose mammary glands
steps.instruction: Euthanize an 8‑week‑old female mouse by CO₂ inhalation, pin the limbs to a foam board, make a midline abdominal skin incision with sterile scissors without breaching the peritoneum, pin the skin back to expose the fourth pair of mammary glands, and gently grasp the distal fat pad with sterile forceps to remove the glands using sterile scissors.

steps.title: Flatten tissue on glass slide
steps.instruction: Transfer the whole mammary gland tissue onto a glass slide, spread it gently with forceps, let the edges dry at room temperature (RT) until the tissue adheres firmly, then place the slide into a 50 mL centrifuge tube for staining.

steps.title: Fix tissue in Carnoy’s fixative
steps.instruction: Add enough freshly prepared Carnoy’s fixative to the 50 mL tube to completely immerse the tissue; incubate in a chemical fume hood for 2–4 h or overnight at RT.

steps.title: Initial ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Transfer the slide to a new 50 mL tube containing 70 % ethanol and wash for 15 min at RT in the fume hood. Tissue can be stored for several months after this step.

steps.title: Sequential ethanol and water washes
steps.instruction: Pass the slide sequentially through 50 % ethanol (5 min), 30 % ethanol (5 min), and distilled water (ddH₂O, 5 min) at RT in the fume hood.

steps.title: Stain with Carmine alum
steps.instruction: Place the slide in Carmine alum solution in the fume hood and incubate at 4 °C overnight; adjust staining time according to tissue size and thickness.

steps.title: Wash until buffer clear
steps.instruction: Wash the slide with wash buffer in the fume hood at RT, repeating until the solution becomes clear.

steps.title: Dehydrate through graded ethanol
steps.instruction: Pass the slide sequentially through 70 % ethanol (15 min), 95 % ethanol (15 min), and 100 % ethanol (15 min) at RT in the fume hood.

steps.title: Clear tissue in xylene
steps.instruction: Transfer the slide to xylene in the fume hood and keep until the tissue is fully cleared (duration as needed).

steps.title: Mount with Permount or neutral balsam
steps.instruction: Apply Permount (or neutral balsam) over the entire tissue in the fume hood, cover with a coverslip if desired, and store the slide at RT.

steps.title: Capture whole‑mount images
steps.instruction: Using a dissecting microscope, capture images of the stained whole mammary gland; include scale bars (e.g., 2.5 mm for whole view, 100 µm for enlarged regions).

steps.title: Quantify epithelial structures
steps.instruction: Count terminal end buds (TEBs) and bifurcated TEBs directly on the images with a counter; also count ducts and acini at 5 mm, 10 mm, and 15 mm from the lymph node along the gland axis.
